sentences.text:
The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks the following prayers:-
"In The Light Of The Facts Circumstances Mentioned Above It Is
Most Humbly Prayed Before This Hon'Ble That The Present
Criminal Miscellaneous Main Petition Under Section 482 Of The
Code Of Criminal Procedure Being Filed For And On Behalf Of The
Petitioner Seeking Direction/Directions, Order
/ORDERS TO EXPEDITE TRIAL WHICH IS PENDNG BEFORE THE COURT OF Ld. M.M. SH.

VINOD KUMAR, DISTRICT AND SESSIONS COURTS, TIS HAZARI, DELHI IN CASE F.I.R. No.254/2010, REGISTERED UNDER SECTIONS 420/468/471 OF THE INDIAN PENAL CODE, REGISTERED AT P.S. LP ESTATE, DISTRICT CENTRAL,
DELHI, MAY KINDLY BE ALLOWED.

entities.text: DISTRICT AND SESSIONS COURTS, TIS HAZARI, DELHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: THAT ANY OTHER ORDER MAY KINDY BE ALLOWED WHILE CONSIDERING THE FACTS CONCERNING THIS PRESENT CASE."

sentences.text: 2. Issue notice.
3. Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner draws the attention of this Court to an order dated 15.12.2023 passed by a coordinate bench of this court in CRL.M.C. 6821/2022 titled Anand v. State GNCTD of Delhi & Ors., wherein, in similar set of facts, directions have been issued with respect to the expeditious disposal of the trial.

entities.text: Anand v. State GNCTD of Delhi & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned APP does not dispute the same.
5. In view of the above, the learned Trial Court is directed to ensure that the trial in the present case is conducted expeditiously without giving any undue adjournment to either of the parties.
6. The petition is allowed and disposed of.

7. Pending applications, if any, also stands disposed of.
8. Order be communicated to the learned Trial Court for necessary information and compliance.
9. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court, forthwith.
AMIT SHARMA, J NOVEMBER 16, 2023/nk
